name: Witch — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Witch from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Witch", "Witch" but are not part of the Witch entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Witch

Drow	Add +¼ hours to the duration of the witch’s disguise hex. This option has no effect unless the witch has selected it 4 times (or another increment of 4); an increase of 45 minutes is effectively the same as no increase in hours of the witch’s disguise hex, for example.	JBE:BoHRC

From d20pfsrd.com: Witch

Safeguard Familiar (Su)

At 3rd level the witch learns of methods to ensure the safety of their familiar, as the loss of their familiar means severance from their spellcasting abilities. While her familiar is on her person or adjacent to her if they would be subject to any attack the witch can choose to take this damage instead. Doing so halves the damage before it’s applied against the witch, and the familiar is left unharmed.
